backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing the ProFi Mine backend with state for mining projects, user profiles, subscription tiers, sensitivity ranges, and Stripe configuration, plus authorization mixins and project CRUD/financial logic.
backend/migration.mo: Stub migration module with empty OldActor and NewActor types and a no-op run function for canister upgrades.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing two implemented features: removing PDF export UI from ExportTab.tsx and fixing the saveProject mutation flow in useQueries.ts.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one- to two-sentence summaries of all frontend source files, used as build planning reference.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes including colors, borders, charts, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell for the React SPA, mounting the app at #root and loading the Vite entry point src/main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with routes for login (/), dashboard, payment-success, and payment-failure pages.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Button component that handles Internet Identity login and logout, showing loading state and clearing React Query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal dialog for new users to enter name, email, organization, and choose a free or premium subscription tier, then persist the profile via the saveCallerUserProfile mutation.
frontend/src/components/charts/CostBreak: Pie chart component that visualizes total mining, processing, G&A, royalties, and closure costs from project calculations, with an image export button that excludes the button itself from the capture.
frontend/src/components/charts/Cumulativ: Renders a line chart of cumulative free cash flow over project years using Recharts, with a download button that exports only the chart area as an image.
frontend/src/components/charts/Productio: Renders a bar chart of annual recovered metal production (in kg) using Recharts, with an export button that saves only the chart area as an image.
frontend/src/components/common/InfoToolt: A small reusable tooltip component that displays a help icon and shows explanatory text on hover using shadcn/ui Tooltip primitives.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Dashbo: Sticky top navigation header displaying the app logo, current project name, subscription usage stats, and buttons for saving, loading, and authentication.
frontend/src/components/export/ExportTab: Export tab UI that allows users to download financial projections as a CSV file, with free-tier export limit tracking and upgrade prompts.
frontend/src/components/guide/Glossary.t: Searchable accordion glossary component that filters and displays term definitions from the GLOSSARY constants.
frontend/src/components/guide/UsageGuide: Usage guide tab with a sticky table of contents sidebar and main content area rendering guide sections and the Glossary component.
frontend/src/components/inputs/CostStruc: Form section for entering cost structure inputs (CAPEX, OPEX, royalties, etc.) with labeled fields, tooltips, and dynamic year-based depreciation configuration.
frontend/src/components/inputs/DynamicAr: Reusable input component for managing a dynamic list of per-year numeric values, with add/remove year buttons and a grid of labeled inputs.
frontend/src/components/inputs/EconomicP: Form section for entering economic parameters (inflation rate, discount rate, tax rate, and commodity price forecast) using labeled inputs with tooltips and a dynamic array input for yearly prices.
frontend/src/components/inputs/Financing: Form section for entering financing parameters (equity ratio and interest rate) with labeled number inputs and tooltips.
frontend/src/components/inputs/InputsTab: Composes all input sections (Reserves/Production, Economic Parameters, Cost Structure, Financing) into a single card-based tab view for project input entry.
frontend/src/components/inputs/ReservesP: Form section for entering reserves and production parameters (ore reserves, grade, recovery rate, stripping ratio, and annual ROM tonnage schedule) with tooltips and a dynamic array input.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Root layout component that wraps the app in a ThemeProvider, renders the router outlet, a toast notifier, and a footer with branding.
frontend/src/components/layout/RootCompo: Top-level component that renders AppLayout and conditionally shows a ProfileSetupModal when an authenticated user has no profile yet.
frontend/src/components/payment/PaymentF: Full-page card displayed when a payment fails, listing common failure reasons and providing buttons to retry or contact support.
frontend/src/components/payment/PaymentS: Full-page card displayed after a successful payment that invalidates the user profile query to refresh subscription status and prompts navigation to the dashboard.
frontend/src/components/project/ProjectL: Dialog modal that lists saved projects with load and delete actions, showing loading/empty states and using an alert dialog to confirm deletion.
frontend/src/components/project/SaveProj: Dialog modal for saving a project by name that enforces subscription usage limits, shows an upgrade prompt when the limit is reached, and handles save errors.
frontend/src/components/projections/Cash: Renders a scrollable table showing yearly cash flow data including Operating Cash Flow, CAPEX, Closure Costs, Free Cash Flow, and Cumulative FCF, with color-coded positive/negative values.
frontend/src/components/projections/Inco: Renders a scrollable yearly income statement table displaying Revenue, OPEX, Royalties, EBITDA, Taxes, and Net Income pulled from project calculations context.
frontend/src/components/projections/Proj: Composes the full Projections tab layout, combining Summary KPIs, cumulative cash flow and production charts, cost breakdown pie chart, and income/cash flow statement tables inside cards.
frontend/src/components/projections/Summ: Displays a simple two-column table of key financial KPIs (NPV, IRR, ROI, LOM, Average EBITDA, Payback Period) with green highlighting for positive values.
frontend/src/components/sensitivity/Scen: Shows a comparison table of NPV, IRR, ROI, and LOM across base, optimistic, and pessimistic scenarios, with edit buttons that open a ScenarioEditor dialog for each scenario.
A dialog component that allows editing percentage adjustments for commodity price, ore grade, recovery rate, CAPEX, and OPEX for a given scenario (base, optimistic, or pessimistic).
frontend/src/components/sensitivity/Sens: Provides sliders to interactively adjust five key variables (±20%) and displays the resulting adjusted NPV, IRR, and ROI compared to base values.
Composes the Sensitivity tab layout, combining the SensitivityControls and SensitivityTornado components in one card and the ScenarioComparison in a second card.

Renders a horizontal bar chart (tornado chart) showing the impact of ±20% variation in key variables on NPV, using data from SensitivityContext. Displays a placeholder message if no tornado data is available.
frontend/src/components/subscription/Sub: A dialog modal that displays the user's current subscription tier and usage, and allows upgrading to Premium by initiating a Stripe checkout session. Handles checkout session creation, redirection, and error toasting.
frontend/src/config/stripe.ts: Exports the Stripe publishable key as a constant for use in frontend Stripe integrations.
frontend/src/constants/glossary.ts: Exports a glossary record mapping mining and financial term keys to their plain-English definitions, covering metrics like NPV, IRR, CAPEX, OPEX, and others.
frontend/src/constants/guideContent.ts: Exports structured guide content with sections covering application overview, getting started steps, input parameter explanations, and financial calculation formulas for the mining financial modeling tool.
frontend/src/contexts/ProjectContext.tsx: Provides a React context managing project inputs, financial calculations, project save/load operations, and subscription tier/usage data fetched from the user profile. Exposes helpers to update inputs and persist projects via mutation hooks.
frontend/src/contexts/ScenarioContext.ts: Provides a React context that computes and stores financial results (NPV, IRR, ROI, LOM) for base, optimistic, and pessimistic scenarios by applying percentage adjustments to project inputs. Wraps children with SensitivityProvider.
frontend/src/contexts/SensitivityContext: Provides a React context for sensitivity analysis, computing adjusted financial results (NPV, IRR, ROI) based on percentage adjustments to key variables and generating tornado chart data with ±20% swings.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated (Internet Identity) access, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useChartExport.ts: Custom hook that exports a Recharts SVG chart to a PNG file by cloning the SVG, inlining computed styles, rendering to a 2x-resolution canvas, and triggering a download.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateCheckoutSess: Custom hook that exposes a React Query mutation to call the backend's createCheckoutSession method with shopping items and return a parsed Stripe checkout session containing an ID and redirect URL.
frontend/src/hooks/useExcelExport.ts: Custom hook that generates a CSV export of the project's financial model (KPIs, assumptions, production schedule, income statement) after verifying and decrementing the user's export quota via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication provider and hook using DFINITY's AuthClient, managing login status, identity persistence, and exposing login/clear actions through a React context.
frontend/src/hooks/usePdfExport.ts: Custom hook that triggers a browser print dialog for PDF export after verifying and decrementing the user's export quota, with a short delay to ensure charts are fully rendered.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles and mining projects via the backend actor, including save/load operations with cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet using Tailwind CSS with mining-themed OKLCH color tokens for light/dark modes and print styles for PDF export of the projections tab.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Main authenticated dashboard page with a five-tab layout (Inputs, Projections, Sensitivity, Export, Guide) wrapped in ProjectProvider and ScenarioProvider contexts, redirecting unauthenticated users to the login page.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login landing page displaying the ProFi Mine branding and an Internet Identity login button, redirecting already-authenticated users to the dashboard.
frontend/src/types/external.d.ts: Empty TypeScript declaration file reserved for external module type augmentations.
frontend/src/utils/calculations.ts: Defines financial data interfaces and implements the core mining project financial model, computing yearly production, revenue, OPEX, taxes, cash flows, NPV, IRR, ROI, and payback period.
frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts: Utility functions for formatting numbers as USD currency, percentages, locale-aware numbers, and dates from nanosecond BigInt timestamps.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL query parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the frontend, extending the default theme with custom OKLCH-based colors, border radii, shadows, accordion animations, and enabling the typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks project state (version 3) for two fix requests: removing PDF export UI elements from ExportTab.tsx and fixing the Save project action in DashboardHeader/ProjectContext.
